rationale: Under the two declared development evaluation cases at configured result count k=1, chunking configuration sentence-pair-v1, canonical knowledge collection course-seed-v1 and the declared local embedding model, no compared configuration returned the reviewed relevant retrieval unit F-A: aggregate recall@1 is 0 of 2 for every configuration. Every returned unit was F-B, judged not relevant, so aggregate precision@1 is 0 of 1 for lexical retrieval and for lexical retrieval followed by embedding-based reranking (Evaluation Case A precision@1 undefined because the ranked candidate output was empty) and 0 of 2 for embedding-based and hybrid retrieval. The embedding-based candidate configuration returned the irrelevant F-B where the lexical experiment baseline returned no unit, and the measured operational evidence does not change this. The evidence therefore does not support adopting the embedding-based candidate configuration in place of the lexical experiment baseline, so the bounded decision retains the experiment-baseline lexical retrieval configuration for these declared cases only; it does not establish downstream concept-definition quality and does not authorize any change to the canonical knowledge collection.
decision boundary: bounded to Evaluation Case A and Evaluation Case B, canonical knowledge collection version course-seed-v1, the sentence-pair-v1 retrieval-unit boundary, the declared relevance judging basis, and the configured result count k=1
authority boundary: a bounded configuration decision about the retrieval configuration; it does not establish the quality of the candidate concept definition produced downstream, does not establish that the complete user workflow achieves its intended result, and does not authorize any change to the canonical knowledge collection
